title: Cosmic Egg Serpent
description: A large cracked white egg with a smiling face and black eyes sits atop a brick chimney rising from dark water. A green snake with a smiling face coils around the egg while multiple smaller green snakes with emoji faces emerge from below. The background features a swirling purple and pink cosmic sky with constellations, floating hearts, musical notes, and glass orbs containing tiny egg figures floating in the water.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene featuring a giant cracked white egg with a smiling face and large black eyes, perched on a brick chimney emerging from dark water. A long green snake with a smiling face coils around it, while multiple smaller green snakes with emoji faces wrap around the base. Floating glass orbs in the water contain miniature versions of the egg character. The swirling purple and pink nebula sky contains constellations, musical notes, smiley faces, and hanging strings of hearts, in a whimsical psychedelic digital painting style.
